data.gender_notes: Hurya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-r-y, meaning 'to let go' or 'to be free'. In Islamic tradition, Hurya represents the spiritual freedom attained through faith and obedience to Allah. The name Hurya carries the meaning “Freedom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hurya usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the liberation of the soul from worldly desires and the attainment of closeness to Allah.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hurya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
